protocol.design: 15 fixed public regression cases; A=original; B=original | direct translation; 3 paired rounds; case order fixed shuffled seed 20261026; AB/BA alternates by case and round
protocol.candidate_policy: Identical ordered 30-candidate pool per case from archived public single-query recall; no retrieval calls, no gold injection; identical pool across all arms and repeats
protocol.labels: Pre-output exhaustive 0/1/2 grades across 50 frozen chunks: 2 directly supports a requested core fact, 1 useful background, 0 irrelevant; agent annotated against corpus, no independent expert adjudication; historical support groups separately preserved
protocol.isolated_variable: Only reranker query string differs; same weights, tokenizer, server, candidate order, timeout=30000ms, source diversity=2, top_k=5, char_budget=12000; fallback/retry OFF in experiment
protocol.generation: One generation per arm/case from first successful repeat; same original question and prompt, temperature=0, thinking disabled, max_tokens=1000. Paired order alternates. Not full Agent workflow.
protocol.translation: One actual API call per question, frozen before reranking; direct faithful translation only; zh/mixed/ar to en, en to zh; explicit translation review before running arms
protocol.cost: Per-request wall/server seconds, cgroup CPU seconds and RSS/cgroup memory samples; exact reranker tokenizer workload collected separately; actual provider usage for translation/generation, estimated USD off-peak/peak range, excludes hardware/electricity and unpriced failures
protocol.budget: 90 measured rerank calls + 2 warmups; 15 translation calls + 30 answer calls; no customer identity/history, DB writes, telemetry export or live configuration mutation
protocol.limits: Small existing regression set, English public corpus snapshot from 2026-10-16; not current-corpus recall test, not independent held-out evaluation, not universal multilingual accuracy
protocol.failure_handling: No reruns or replacements; all attempts count toward availability/wall/CPU; ranking quality restricted to complete successful pairs, missing pairs disclosed.
